selection.eligibility: all 22 completed eligible cases ranked; forecast-error metrics are tie-breaks, not vetoes; failed/incomplete cases excluded
selection.same_event_selection_limitation: This is same-event parameter selection, not independent validation or a significance test.
selection.initialization_limitation: QSNOW-only initial-water sensitivity is diagnostic; it does not claim conservative or operational initialization.
selection.precipitation_limitation: The score verifies total surface precipitation, not surface snowfall alone.
